conbody.p: The organization that you function within needs to know that there may have been a breach because a breach on your end may put other data at risk. This will allow the institution to begin thier own incident response plan to ensure the maximum amount of time to remediate.

If you had other tabs open at the time of the breach or if the password/account breach had a password that you use with other institutions you need to let them know so they can be alert for suspicous activity from those accounts.
Changing the passwords immediately lowers the risk that the attackers can get back into the system.
